column1: # Acceptance criteria for scenarios/engine_dtc_amber.csv. Format: docs/acceptance.md.

column6: SR-1: no override requested before the starter is pressed
speed control taken within 2 s of start and kept: limp-home is not a fault
SR-2: requested speed never above high idle (2100 rpm)
SR-3: pump commanded only while in speed control
SR-10: every TSC1 carries a valid checksum and a counter that moves by one
pump follows the hoist lever (85 %) within 100 ms
SR-13: limp-home within 1 s of the amber lamp: requested speed 1200 rpm and pump 50 %
SR-13: into limp-home without dropping below it: speed and pump stay at or above the limp-home values
SR-13: back at the operator's 1500 rpm and 85 % within 1.5 s of the lamp going off
